answer: By the onyx of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Work waits on the whisper until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the pearl of the next round. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, diluted when peers disagree.
